definitions.gloss: victory in war; triumph in battle
definitions.explanation: Winning a war or battle. A formal term used in historical, military, and political contexts.

examples.japanese: {戦勝|せんしょう}{記念日|きねんび}を{祝|いわ}う。
{戦勝|せんしょう}{国|こく}が{条約|じょうやく}の{内容|ないよう}を{決|き}めた。
examples.english: The victorious nations determined the terms of the treaty.

examples.japanese: {戦勝|せんしょう}パレードには{多|おお}くの{市民|しみん}が{沿道|えんどう}に{集|あつ}まった。
examples.english: Many citizens gathered along the roadside for the victory parade.

notes: Composed of {戦|せん} (war, battle) + {勝|しょう} (victory, win). A formal/historical term. The opposite is {戦敗|せんぱい} (war defeat) or more commonly {敗戦|はいせん} (defeat in war). Common collocations: {戦勝|せんしょう}{国|こく} (victorious nation), {戦勝|せんしょう}{記念|きねん} (victory commemoration), {戦勝|せんしょう}パレード (victory parade). In the context of World War II, the {戦勝|せんしょう}{国|こく} (Allied victors) include the five permanent members of the UN Security Council. {戦勝|せんしょう}{記念日|きねんび} (Victory Day) is observed in many countries, notably Russia's May 9 celebration.
